hooks.command: cmd=$(node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));console.log(d.tool_input?.command||'')"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s+.*(--force|-f)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"禁止 force-push(包含 --force/-f)。如确需此操作,请手动在终端执行。"}}'; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s+.*origin\s+(main|master)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"禁止推送到 main/master。如确需此操作,请手动在终端执行。"}}'; fi
